Title: Extending molecular scaffolds with building blocks
Description: Grows a molecule outward from a starting scaffold by attaching chemically sensible fragments, returning up to 1,000 elaborated structures. Maziarz and colleagues built the generator around structural motifs rather than single atoms, so that each step adds a complete ring or functional group and intermediate states stay valid. Training used a large corpus of drug-like molecules to learn which motifs plausibly follow which. Sampling is stochastic, and generated compounds still require assessment for novelty and synthetic accessibility.
Interpretation: Up to 1000 generated molecules produced by extending the input scaffold with structural motifs.
